study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Segal et al., Biological Psychiatry: CNNI, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Multiscale Heterogeneity of White Matter Morphometry in Psychiatric Disorders

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative modeling used warped Bayesian linear regression (Bayesian linear regression with likelihood warping).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We applied warped Bayesian linear regression normative models to T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging data; We used normative modeling to obtain person-specific WMV deviation maps relative to a model, based on Bayesian linear regression with likelihood warping
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Segal2025.pdf.md: ABSTRACT / METHODS; Segal2025.pdf.md: Voxel-Scale WMV Heterogeneity

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Voxelwise white matter volume (WMV) from T1-weighted MRI (VBM-based).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: voxelwise WMV; We estimated voxelwise WMV using voxel-based morphometry (VBM) of T1-weighted anatomical MRI scans
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Segal2025.pdf.md: Analysis Overview; Segal2025.pdf.md: Voxel-Scale WMV Heterogeneity

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Predictors included age (modeled with B-spline basis expansion for non-linear effects), sex, and scan site.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: fitted separate models to each white matter voxel to predict WMV as a function of age, sex, and site; B-spline basis expansion over age was used to model non-linear effects, and likelihood warping was used to model non-Gaussian and heteroscedastic imaging phenotypes. To handle the site effect, we included scan site as a covariate
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Segal2025.pdf.md: Voxel-Scale WMV Heterogeneity; 1-s2.0-S2451902225001272-mmc1.pdf.md: Normative modelling
